body.en:
Complex numbers revisited

On advanced ACT items, complex numbers appear in equation-solving contexts: \( x^2+4=0 \Rightarrow x=\pm 2i \). The modulus of \( a+bi \) is \( \sqrt{a^2+b^2} \).

An arithmetic sequence: \(a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d\). A geometric sequence: \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\). Modular arithmetic: \(a \equiv b \pmod{m}\) means \(m \mid (a-b)\). Useful for finding last digits (mod 10) or remainders.

label.en: Worked example — Last digit of a power

body.en:
What is the units digit of \(7^{2026}\)?

Powers of 7 cycle: \(7^1=7, 7^2=49, 7^3=343, 7^4=2401, 7^5=\ldots7\). Cycle length 4. \(2026 \div 4\) remainder \(2\). So units digit = same as \(7^2\) = 9.

label.en: ▲ ACT Math 2 Traps & Pitfalls — Number Theory & Complex Numbers

body.en:
• Powers of \(i\) Cycle Modulo 4: \(i^1 = i\), \(i^2 = -1\), \(i^3 = -i\), and \(i^4 = 1\). To evaluate \(i^k\), find \(k \pmod 4\): remainder 1 gives \(i\), remainder 2 gives \(-1\), remainder 3 gives \(-i\), and remainder 0 gives \(1\).
  • Complex Fraction Rationalization: To simplify \(\dfrac{a+bi}{c+di}\), multiply both numerator and denominator by the complex conjugate \(c - di\). The denominator becomes the real number \(c^2 + d^2\).
  • Infinite Geometric Series Convergence: The sum formula \(S_\infty = \dfrac{a_1}{1 - r}\) is strictly valid ONLY when \(|r| < 1\). If \(|r| \ge 1\), the series diverges and has no finite sum.
  • GCD vs. LCM Relationship: Remember the product identity \(\text{GCD}(a,b) \times \text{LCM}(a,b) = a \times b\). If a question asks for the LCM given prime factorizations, take the highest power of each distinct prime; for GCD, take the lowest common power.

question.en: The sum of an arithmetic sequence is 150, with first term 5 and last term 25. How many terms are there?
Express the complex number \(z = \dfrac{5 + 2i}{3 - 4i}\) in standard form \(a + bi\), and determine its modulus \(|z|\).

solution.en:
(a) Standard form \(a + bi\): Multiply numerator and denominator by the complex conjugate \(3 + 4i\): \[ z = \dfrac{(5 + 2i)(3 + 4i)}{(3 - 4i)(3 + 4i)} = \dfrac{15 + 20i + 6i + 8i^2}{3^2 - (4i)^2} = \dfrac{15 + 26i - 8}{9 - (-16)} = \dfrac{7 + 26i}{25} = \dfrac{7}{25} + \dfrac{26}{25}i. \]

(b) Modulus \(|z|\): Using the modulus quotient property \(|z| = \dfrac{|5+2i|}{|3-4i|}\): \(|5+2i| = \sqrt{5^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{29}\), and \(|3-4i| = \sqrt{3^2 + (-4)^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5\). Thus \(|z| = \dfrac{\sqrt{29}}{5}\) (or \(\approx 1.077\)).
